gloss: exam question; test question; examination problem

definitions.gloss: exam question; test question; examination problem
definitions.explanation: The individual questions or problems that appear on a test or examination. Widely used in educational contexts from school tests to university entrance exams.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{問題|もんだい}は{難|むずか}しかった。
{先生|せんせい}が{試験|しけん}{問題|もんだい}を{作|つく}っている。
examples.english: The teacher is making the test questions.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{試験|しけん}{問題|もんだい}を{解|と}いて{対策|たいさく}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: I practiced past exam questions to prepare a study strategy.

notes:
A compound noun combining {試験|しけん} (exam) and {問題|もんだい} (question/problem). Refers to the questions that appear on a test or examination. Widely used in educational contexts from elementary school through university entrance exams.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {試験|しけん}{問題|もんだい}を{解|と}く: to solve exam questions
- {試験|しけん}{問題|もんだい}を{作成|さくせい}する: to create exam questions
- {過去|かこ}の{試験|しけん}{問題|もんだい}: past exam questions
- {試験|しけん}{問題|もんだい}が{漏|も}れる: exam questions are leaked

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {設問|せつもん} — question (on a test); more formal, often refers to individual questions within a larger exam
- {出題|しゅつだい} — setting questions (the act of creating exam questions)
- {問題集|もんだいしゅう} — problem set; workbook of practice questions
